title: Inference-Time Rule Eraser: Fair Recognition via Distilling and Removing Biased Rules
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks and experiments focus on fairness and bias related to attributes such as gender, race, ethnicity, and spurious correlations (e.g., background color, natural noise).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on debiasing machine learning models with respect to attributes like gender and race.
